data.gender_notes: Allistir is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἀλλοστόρικος (Allostorikos), meaning 'other-ruler' or 'rule of God'. In early Christian use, this name was given to those who ruled in the name of God or to those who were protectors of the faith. The name Allistir carries the meaning “Rule of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Allistir usually hope their child will grow to embody rule of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
